You will build features end to end — the interfaces, the APIs behind them and their tests — across the company's products. You'll make early versions production-ready, own modules from roadmap to release, and make every product fast, clear and reliable.

This is a small, senior-minded team. You'll own real parts of the product, share on-call, and see your work used by real people the same week you ship it.

Building features end to end user interfaces, APIs and tests across web and mobile.

Writing automated tests for the flows that matter, and reviewing teammates' code as carefully as they review yours.

Fixing what breaks, fast and sharing on-call duty.

Documenting your work so anyone can pick it up.

You've shipped real things. Three to five years building production web applications with React and TypeScript, and the Node.js APIs behind them. You can show us something live and walk us through the code.

You care how it feels to use. You notice when a screen is slow, confusing or breaks on a phone — and you fix it before anyone asks.

You finish properly. Tested, documented, deployed — not "works on my machine".

You use AI tools well. You move faster with them, and you read and test everything they write.

You ask before you build when something's unclear, and you take code-review feedback as a gift.

Thirty days in, you've shipped your first feature to production through the full pipeline.

Ninety days in, you own at least one module end to end and ship changes there independently.

Six months in, you're a go-to owner for several parts of the product, and the products you touch are measurably faster and more reliable.

description:

At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.

Think finance is stuffy? Think again.

At Equiti, we’re building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we’re on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our
**Technology**
department would like to welcome a hands-on

**Lead Enterprise Risk Engineer**
in our office in
**Bengaluru, India**

As Lead Enterprise Risk Engineer, you lead the engineering of Equiti’s shared risk infrastructure: one realtime, auditable decision layer that every product surface plugs into, across KYC, onboarding, trading, stocks, wealth and payments. Your goal is to keep fraud, financial crime and abuse losses as low as possible without adding friction for good clients. Reporting to the Group Head of AI Labs, you partner with product, Compliance and Risk teams across the Group.

In fintech and wealthtech, fraud losses, chargebacks and regulatory penalties go straight to the P&L, and a single AML failure can put a licence at risk. You will build a central risk and decision engine that consumes data from every team and provides the rules, sanctions screening and interventions they all rely on, so risk decisions are consistent, real time and auditable.

This is a build-led role. You set the architecture and stay close to the code, guide a team of risk-focused engineers, and act as the independent technical challenge point for platform and architecture changes that affect risk.

**Responsibilities**

**Risk Decisioning Platform**

* Own the design and build of a sanction-grade, real-time risk decisioning engine that blends rules and ML scoring into a single decision API used across Equiti’s products.
* Deliver a self-serve rules engine so risk analysts can author, test and roll back rules without an engineering deploy.
* Build velocity, limits and enforcement controls that are highly available and fully auditable, so every decision can be traced for regulators and auditors.

**Fraud & Financial Crime**

* Own the device and session intelligence layer, including build-vs-buy decisions.
* Partner with Data Science to deploy and govern fraud models (account takeover, synthetic identity, mule detection, payment fraud, promo abuse), with confirmed outcomes feeding back into rules and models.
* Deliver sanctions and PEP screening and AML transaction monitoring in partnership with Compliance, tuned to keep false positives low.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of risk-focused engineers, and set the team’s technical standards, priorities and roadmap.
* Provide independent technical challenge on platform and architecture changes that affect risk.
* Report on control effectiveness and risk posture at governance forums, and build strong relationships across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Data Science and Audit.

**Experience Requirements**

* 8+ years in software or data engineering, including 4+ years building fraud, financial crime or risk systems in financial services or a similarly regulated environment.
* Proven experience building and running real-time, low-latency decisioning or scoring services in production.
* Hands-on experience with rules engines and ML models in production: feature pipelines, model serving and monitoring.
* Working knowledge of sanctions, PEP screening and AML transaction monitoring regulatory requirements and control design.
* Strong technical grounding in SQL and Python, cloud data platforms such as Databricks, and BI and visualisation tools.
* Experience with streaming and event-driven architectures for real-time data.
* A track record of building monitoring, alerting and dashboard solutions.
* Technical leadership experience: mentoring engineers, setting standards and growing technical talent.
* Experience providing independent architecture or technical design challenge, and the credibility to influence senior technology, risk and compliance leaders.
* Degree in a relevant technical, risk or quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical

experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Background in brokerage, trading, wealth or payments.
* Experience integrating third-party device intelligence or fraud detection providers.
* Graph or network analytics for mule and linked-account detection.
* Experience working with regulators across multiple jurisdictions.
* Familiarity with model risk management frameworks.

**Perks**

Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
